identification: Single rough-sawn live-edge slab, about 40 cm wide and 2 m long, catalogued as Huon pine. One photo only. Face is a plain, even, orange-tan colour with straight fine grain and a few small knots; the neighbouring slabs are paler. Huon pine is normally pale yellow to golden, so this could be Huon pine with an aged surface, or another softwood or a different species. Not confirmed from the photo.

viewing_check: Confirm the species. Huon pine has a sweet resinous smell when scratched or sanded, fine even grain, pale yellow to golden colour and is light and soft. Photograph a freshly scratched or planed patch and the end grain, and note the weight. Measure thickness (45 mm or more is much better), check for splits and rot, and whether it is straight.
